purpose: Reduce duplicate item/object master generation safely by reviewing exact-name collisions before any physical-object lineage is declared. Exact text equality is evidence of a naming collision only, never proof of one physical object.

currentReviewConclusion.reason: Current sources define gameplay/name roles but do not specify physical construction continuity, material continuity or a source-backed transformation path for these exact-name collisions.

roleSemantics.passiveItem: character-compatible carried/owned gameplay item shown in level-up or inventory contexts
roleSemantics.rareItem: forgotten/lived object that can act as an awakening/story key
roleSemantics.lampTsugi: name of the post-Lamp-Tsugi evolved gameplay state; the source does not by itself say the passive item physically transforms into it
roleSemantics.akatsukiBiraki: name of the Akatsuki-biraki reached state/final presentation; the source does not by itself say the rare item is physically identical to it

nonCollisionRows.rule: Unique text does not prove unique physical object either. Later semantic lineage review may still relate differently named starter/passive/rare/evolution states; this queue only closes the exact-label auto-dedupe hazard.

fieldDrops.notes: Field drops are separate gameplay/world pickup identities unless a future authority explicitly links them to another physical object.
